visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Highest Bit Is Never Counted
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 7 is 111 in binary and has three 1 bits, but the program prints 2.

solution.explanation: The last iteration happens when n is exactly 1: that is the top bit, and it still has to be counted. Stopping at n > 1 leaves it out, so the answer is always one too low for odd results.
